title: Fourier estimator sample count
statement: For rational parameters $\varepsilon,\delta$ with $0<\varepsilon,\delta\leq 1/2$, the Fourier estimator sample count is the least natural number at least $2B(\delta)/\varepsilon^2$, where $B(\delta)$ denotes the quantity assigned to $\delta$ by the estimator’s failure-bit function.
caveat: The snippet does not define the failure-bit function, so its mathematical meaning cannot be specified more precisely from the supplied information.
